scope: Latest chronological actual chain per(N,chi,initial), not best fit. Earlier failed chains retained in all source indices. Different r values use the saved fixed-midpoint pair rules; no absolute-value log envelope or node deletion. K/c window spread is sensitivity, not a statistical confidence interval.
